title: dpsc-wls-validation: WLS (Gpr177/Wntless) expression in human dental pulp stem cells across four public scRNA-seq datasets
description: R pipeline and result tables testing whether WLS (Gpr177/Wntless) is expressed in, and enriched in, candidate dental pulp stem cells (DPSCs). Datasets: GEO GSE164157 (discovery, 5 donors), GSE202476, GSE185222 and GSE227731 (PRJNA946721). Result: WLS is expressed in DPSCs in all four datasets but enriched in none.
